scenario.note: The objective maximizes sugar beet grown while maintaining non-negative yearly profit across all five years, preserving the total five-year profit at its original level.
The objective is maximized sugar beet grown, subject to the total five-year profit being zero (fully intact).
The first stage maximizes the total profit over five years, then the second stage maximizes sugar beet sales across all years, subject to the first stage's optimum.
The first objective maximises total profit (as in the base model), then the second maximises total sugar beet sold across all years, subject to the same profit level.
